content:
The iPhone Duo was officially announced this week, but won't go on sale until October. Reports indicate Apple has several other new products set to debut in October as well — here's what to expect.

Three brand-new Macs, including a redesigned high-end MacBook with a touchscreen display

It's already been a bountiful year for the Mac, with the MacBook Neo, M5 MacBook Air, and high-end M5 MacBook Pro launching in the spring, followed more recently by the Mac mini and Mac Studio.

However, Apple has even more new models on the way, including the first-ever MacBook with a touchscreen display. Three Macs are reportedly in the works:

  • All-new MacBook Pro/Ultra: A completely redesigned high-end MacBook featuring touch input, OLED, and more
  • M6 MacBook Pro: An updated version of the 14-inch base model MacBook Pro
  • M6 iMac: A more powerful chip and new colour options

Apple smart home lineup gets an upgrade with Siri AI

We're still waiting for the rumoured comprehensive revamp and expansion of Apple's smart home product line. With no appearance at this week's event, October has emerged as the speculated launch window.

Top liked comment posted by wrxrox

The Apple TV has been the product I've wanted most since the previous generation launched in 2022. The other products are pretty good too

The Apple smart home upgrade is expected to centre on Siri AI and other Apple Intelligence features exclusive to the new hardware. The rumoured products include:

  • All-new Apple TV 4K: A19 or A19 Pro chip, Siri AI, and a new Siri Remote
  • HomePad/HomePod Touch: A smart home hub with a built-in touchscreen display
  • HomePod mini 2: A more powerful chip, improved sound, and more
  • HomePod 3: An all-new HomePod model with Siri AI support is also a possibility

An OLED-equipped iPad mini, plus possibly a new base-model iPad

According to Bloomberg, an upgraded iPad mini will launch this autumn, while the base-model iPad is also due for an update — though that may not arrive until early 2027.

  • All-new iPad mini: OLED display, A19 Pro or A20 Pro chip
  • Base-model iPad: A18 chip to support Apple Intelligence

Which October Apple product are you most looking forward to? Let us know in the comments.
